# Components and context variables

Every type stored in a registry (per-entity component, tag, or `reg.ctx()` variable), with the systems that touch it.

| Component | Kind | Registry | Writers | Readers | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AgentIO](AgentIO.md) | context | world | 5 | 8 | The world's agent as the training host sees it: behaviour, sizes, action in, observation / reward / done / stats out. |
| [Camera](Camera.md) | context | host | 5 | 10 | Free-flying desktop camera: position, yaw, pitch and projection parameters. |
| [ChunkC](ChunkC.md) | component | host | 1 | 5 | A marching cubes chunk at integer chunk coordinates. |
| [ChunkDestroying](ChunkDestroying.md) | tag | host | 1 | 3 | Chunk is beyond the unload distance and will be destroyed once no worker uses it. |
| [ChunkEmpty](ChunkEmpty.md) | component | host | 1 | 1 | Marks a chunk whose samples are all on the same side of the surface, with their mean. |
| [ChunkGenerated](ChunkGenerated.md) | tag | host | 1 | 3 | Chunk densities are ready: ChunkVolume or ChunkEmpty is present. |
| [ChunkGenerating](ChunkGenerating.md) | tag | host | 1 | 2 | Chunk density is being computed on a worker thread. |
| [ChunkGPU](ChunkGPU.md) | component | host | 1 | 3 | GPU mesh slot of a chunk entity: index into TerrainBuffers::vertices and the indirect draw buffer. |
| [ChunkMap](ChunkMap.md) | context | host | 1 | 3 | Chunk coordinates to chunk entity, for the live (not unloading) chunks. |
| [ChunkMeshPending](ChunkMeshPending.md) | tag | host | 1 | 2 | Chunk waits for a marching cubes dispatch. |
| [ChunkReady](ChunkReady.md) | tag | host | 1 | 3 | The chunk's mesh was recorded into a compute batch submitted before this frame's graphics, so it is drawable. |
| [ChunkVolume](ChunkVolume.md) | component | host | 1 | 2 | The 67^3 density samples of a chunk that crosses the surface. |
| [Context*](Context.md) | context | host | 1 | 3 | Pointer to the renderer's Vulkan/OpenXR Context (VRContext, Windu, Instance, Device + VMA, Transfer, Compute, Swapchain, view descriptor layout, frame index). |
| [FixedStepClock](FixedStepClock.md) | context | host | 1 | 2 | Host fixed-step accumulator shared by TerrainCollidersSys (looks ahead at this frame's steps) and PhysicsSys (takes them). |
| [FrameClock](FrameClock.md) | context | host | 1 | 1 | Frame delta, accumulated time and frame number of the dynamical frame loop. |
| [Ground](Ground.md) | component | world | 3 | 2 | A flat static Jolt box whose top face is at top_y, centred on the origin in XZ. |
| [HeightField](HeightField.md) | component | world | 3 | 1 | Static Jolt height field of rolling hills, a sum of random plane waves, centred on the origin. |
| [Input](Input.md) | context | host | 6 | 8 | Per-frame keyboard, mouse and window state of the desktop window. |
| [ModelC](ModelC.md) | component | host | 3 | 2 | GPU mesh of one loaded glTF file (or code-built mesh), on its own entity; instances reference it through ModelRenderable::model. |
| [ModelManager](ModelManager.md) | context | host | 2 | 8 | Context variable caching loaded models: path (or key) -> entity holding the ModelC. |
| [ModelRef](ModelRef.md) | component | world | 3 | 1 | A glTF path and tint to draw at the entity's Transform. |
| [ModelRenderable](ModelRenderable.md) | component | host | 8 | 1 | Draws the ModelC held by another entity at this entity's Transform, tinted. |
| [Parked](Parked.md) | context | world | 4 | 1 | World flag: the agent's episode ended mid-window and the world waits for the Observe phase. |
| [PhysicsPose](PhysicsPose.md) | component | both | 5 | 5 | The last two simulated poses of a dynamic Jolt body. |
| [PhysicsStats](PhysicsStats.md) | context | both | 3 | 1 | Physics counters and timings shown by the debug menu. |
| [PhysicsWorld](PhysicsWorld.md) | context | both | 8 | 10 | A Jolt PhysicsSystem with its job system and temp allocator, one per registry. |
| [PolicyHandle](PolicyHandle.md) | context | world | 1 | 1 | The ONNX policy a world's PolicySys runs. |
| [PolicySources](PolicySources.md) | context | host | 1 | 2 | What each world's policy is, for panels and overlays. |
| [RenderSettings](RenderSettings.md) | context | host | 2 | 4 | Runtime toggles of the scene passes and the grass shader parameters. |
| [RigidBody](RigidBody.md) | component | both | 9 | 13 | A Jolt body (box, sphere or capsule; static, dynamic or kinematic) attached to the entity's Transform. |
| [RunArgs](RunArgs.md) | context | host | 1 | 7 | Parsed key=value process arguments: scene, variables, mode, capture and probe settings. |
| [Settings](Settings.md) | context | host | 2 | 3 | User settings loaded from ./config.6.json and overridden by key=value arguments. |
| [SphereAgent](SphereAgent.md) | component | world | 6 | 4 | The sphere_roll agent next to the sphere's Transform and RigidBody: task settings and episode state. |
| [std::shared_ptr<TerrainColliders>](shared_ptr-TerrainColliders.md) | context | world | 3 | 2 | The world's marching-cubes collider cache, shared by WorldTerrainSys so agents can query or require ground cells. |
| [std::shared_ptr<TerrainGenerator>](shared_ptr-TerrainGenerator.md) | context | both | 2 | 5 | Shared density function of the marching cubes world (FastNoise2 heightfield plus 3D overhang noise). |
| [TerrainBuffers](TerrainBuffers.md) | context | host | 1 | 3 | Context variable exposing TerrainSys's indirect draw buffer and per-slot vertex buffers to the terrain and grass passes. |
| [tf::Executor](tf-Executor.md) | context | host | 2 | 4 | The host's Taskflow thread pool. |
| [Time](Time.md) | context | host | 1 | 1 | Legacy in-game calendar clock in integer game seconds. |
| [Transform](Transform.md) | component | both | 15 | 11 | Position, rotation and scale of an entity in world space. |
| [VRHands](VRHands.md) | context | host | 1 | 1 | The two host entities drawing (and colliding as) the VR controllers. |
| [VRInput](VRInput.md) | context | host | 2 | 5 | Head and controller poses and buttons, in stage space, written each frame by the VR renderer. |
| [VRRig](VRRig.md) | context | host | 4 | 5 | Placement of the OpenXR stage space (play area) in the world. |
| [WorldClock](WorldClock.md) | context | world | 1 | 6 | A world's fixed tick length, decision period and tick counter. |
| [WorldInfo](WorldInfo.md) | context | world | 1 | 2 | A world's index, seed and template name. |
| [WorldRng](WorldRng.md) | context | world | 6 | 5 | The world's own deterministic random stream (mt19937_64 with platform-independent distributions). |
| [Worlds](Worlds.md) | context | host | 2 | 6 | The scene's worlds, in index order (host context variable in dynamical). |
| [WorldStepperState](WorldStepperState.md) | context | host | 1 | 4 | Interpolation factor and pause state of the real-time world stepper. |
| [WorldViewLink](WorldViewLink.md) | component | host | 1 | 0 | Marks a host entity created by WorldViewSys as the mirror of one shape of a world entity. |
